The phone recharges at the rate of 1 percentage-point of charge per 3 minutes.

Step 2: Calculate the remaining charge
The phone is currently at 60% charged. To find out how much charge is remaining, we subtract the current charge from 100%:
Remaining charge = 100% - 60% = 40%

Step 3: Calculate the time to reach 100% charged
To find out how long it takes to reach 100% charged, we divide the remaining charge by the rate of charge:
Time to reach 100% charged = Remaining charge / Rate of charge
Time to reach 100% charged = 40% / 1% per 3 minutes
Time to reach 100% charged = 40 / (1 * 3)
Time to reach 100% charged = 40 / 3
Time to reach 100% charged = 13.33 minutes

Step 4: Convert the time to hours
To convert the time to hours, we divide the time in minutes by 60:
Time in hours = Time to reach 100% charged / 60
Time in hours = 13.33 / 60
Time in hours = 0.23 hours

Therefore, it will take approximately 0.23 hours to fully charge the cell phone.
